newsitem.title: USA: National Energy to buy Panaco fields.
newsitem.headline: National Energy to buy Panaco fields.

text.p: National Energy Group Inc said it agreed to acquire producing oil and gas properties in Louisiana from Panaco Inc for about $11 million in cash and stock.
National Energy said it would pay $9 million in cash.
The purchase is expected to close around November 22.
The properties, located in Bayou Sorrel in Iberville Parish, are estimated to contain more than one million barrels of crude oil and four billion cubic feet of natural gas in multiple horizons.

"The Bayou Sorrel Field is adjacent to our recently announced discovery well, the C.E. Schwing #1, which tested at 1,026 barrels of oil and 980,000 cubic feet of natural gas per day," the company said.
The infrastructure acquired as part of the deal will bring greater efficiency to National's increased development and exploration operations in the area.
The recent discovery produces from a horizon that has not been tested in the acquired field.
